Sangamo Therapeutics — three-stage event, registered as bankruptcy on the date the SGMO symbol stopped resolving. (1) Nasdaq delisting determination for continued failure of the $1.00 minimum bid price; trading suspended and moved to OTCQB 2026-05-05. (2) Hearings-panel appeal stayed delisting but not the trading suspension. (3) Voluntary Chapter 11 petition; common stock began trading on OTCID Basic 2026-06-24 under the NEW symbol SGMOQ. Frozen price series carries to 2026-07-01. Remove from universe. NOTE: effective_date 2026-06-24 chosen because that is when the SGMO ticker ceased to resolve, matching where our price feed dies; the Nasdaq venue change was 2026-05-05. A separate ticker_change SGMO->SGMOQ action was deliberately NOT added, to avoid resolve_ticker() redirecting fetches to a bankrupt sub-$0.10 OTCID listing. [registered 2026-08-05 — see CPRX note]
